answer: Clone mills still stamp spare keys from one press. To hold a ballot, a claimant must plane a 28 cm cedar tablet, stain it with a batch-tagged saffron lake whose absorbance is logged at 6 wavelengths, and incise a 14-line sonnet whose meter hash is unique to that tablet. The piece is escrowed with 43 POA for 12 days; three conservators re-scan the lake curve within 0.7% and replay the meter hash on-ledger. Cost: 43 POA locked 12 days. If two keys share a tablet, saffron curves collide, or a sonnet hash is reused, 53% of the bond burns and that lot is barred for 6 epochs.
